## Knowledge base (local graph-RAG, ontology RDF)
- Before answering about the documents in raw/ or the notes in wiki/, **consult the KB** with the `/kb` skill (`KB ask` first). Cite every fact (`file, p.N` or `file, sheet X, row N`) and answer in the user's language.
- **Precedence:** most recent document wins (date, then version within the same document family); raw/ wins over wiki/ unless a note lists the source in `overrides:`. Overdue notes keep precedence but the answer must warn.
- **Never index docs/** (deliverables generated here).
- **Documents only in subagents:** any processing of document content beyond the compact output of the engine (multi-page reading, Grep in raw/, extraction, images, graphify) runs in a subagent that returns only results with citations.
- At the start of KB work: `KB status` (curator lock, overdue notes, OneDrive conflict copies, engine version), where `KB` is `uv run ~/.claude/skills/kb-setup/scripts/kb.py` if that file exists, else `uv run scripts/kb-engine/kb.py` (workspace copy), else see the next bullet.
- **kb-setup meta skill:** when it is missing and needed (no engine at all, or curation with only the workspace copy: upgrade, eval, review, skills, ontology), explain and offer to install it with `npx skills add wagnerpinheiro/graphify-kb --skill kb-setup -g -a claude-code` (needs Node.js; confirm first; open a new session afterwards). When the engine warns about a newer kb-setup or engine version, suggest `/kb-setup upgrade`.
- After changes in raw/ or wiki/: `/kb update` (no hooks; manual). Only the curator updates; others may use read-only mode.
- OneDrive/Teams consumers: `KB audit` (or `--quick`, without downloading) checks that this copy has every file of the curator's last update (`kb/inventory.json`); MISSING or DIFFERENT files mean answers may be incomplete.
- When editing notes in wiki/: update `last_reviewed` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `reviewed_by`. New notes: `/kb new-note "<title>"` (`type: fleeting | literature | permanent`, `[[links]]`).
- **Full reading by an LLM** (prose extraction, graphify over raw/, eval baselines) only with explicit per-document authorization (recorded in kb/SETUP.md).
- Execution: one simple command per Bash call (auto mode); no MCP, hooks or settings changes; no external LLM keys.
- Improvements: suggestions go to kb/IMPROVEMENTS.md; `/kb-setup review` applies approved ones.

## graphify (required) and coexistence with /kb
- graphify {{GRAPHIFY_VERSION}} from the graphify-kb fork ({{GRAPHIFY_SOURCE}}) is part of this workspace: `/kb update` also updates `graphify-out/`. If `graphify --version` differs from `graphify.version` in kb/config.yaml, run `/kb-setup upgrade` before rebuilding.
- **Questions about the sources go to `/kb`, even when graphify-out/ exists.** graphify does not apply precedence nor cite page/row reliably.
- graphify only when explicitly requested (`/graphify ...`), for exploration (themes, communities, paths between concepts) or for code.
- Authorized graphify scope: {{GRAPHIFY_SCOPE}} (documents in raw/ only those not listed in `raw/.graphifyignore`; widening requires per-document authorization). No Gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY/GOOGLE_API_KEY must be unset), no `graphify add`, no `--mcp/--neo4j/--watch`/hooks.
- graphify-out/ (root) and any `*/graphify-out/` cache stay out of git and of the KB. graphify builds and updates run only in a subagent, as part of `/kb update` or `/kb-setup graphify`.
